name: Dover Playgrounds Program
description_short: City run summer playground program at Horne Street Park for Dover children aged 6 to 12, weekdays 8:30 to 3:30 for seven weeks. Counselors lead games, sports, swimming and arts and crafts, with a trip to a New Hampshire state park each Friday.

sessions.name: Full program, 7 weeks (tentative dates; no camp July 3)

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page; 2026 program for Dover residents ages 6 to 12 at Horne Street Park, 50 children; June 22 to August 7 marked tentative; $400 for the whole summer if paid by May 31, $450 after June 1; zip is from the City Hall address in the page footer

warnings: Open to Dover residents only, so there is no non-resident rate to list.
The 2026 dates (June 22 to August 7) are marked tentative on the page.
The program is weather dependent and is cancelled in bad weather.
One price covers all seven weeks: $400 by May 31, $450 after June 1.
unknowns: street address of Horne Street Park
phone (the page gives 516-6401 without an area code)

for_andrew: Residents only program with a single summer fee and tentative dates. List it, given non-residents cannot enroll?
